title: Pop-Up Café Challenge

title: Contract Clash
tagline: Your client’s bakery got burned by a supplier. Win it, settle it, or lose it.

Call the supplier for a chat

rounds.brief: Is it real or a convenient excuse?

Mention it in front of the class

title: The Boardroom
tagline: You are CEO of Lanka Fresh, a mid-sized FMCG company facing retail and regulatory disruption.

rounds.title: Strategic review
rounds.brief: Board paper: growth has stalled at 2% while private labels take share. The board expects a clear direction.

options.text: Data partnership with a supermarket chain

rounds.title: Channel pressure
rounds.brief: Your response will signal the company’s negotiating posture for years.
rounds.event: The largest retailer demands an additional 8% margin or reduced shelf space.

rounds.title: Regulatory shift
rounds.brief: Compliance is mandatory; leadership is optional.
rounds.event: Government announces single-use plastic packaging restrictions within 18 months.

options.text: Comply at minimum, on the deadline

rounds.title: Investor day
rounds.brief: Analysts and institutional investors expect a capital allocation plan and a credible narrative.

options.text: Long-term value plan with ESG targets

title: Turnaround CEO
tagline: Serendib Hospitality Group is losing money after a tourism downturn. You have 24 months.

rounds.title: The first 100 days
rounds.brief: You inherit six hotels, high debt and a demoralised workforce. Lenders want a plan in 30 days.

rounds.title: External shock
rounds.brief: Forward bookings drop 30% overnight.
rounds.event: A key source market issues a travel advisory for the region.

options.text: Pivot to domestic and regional travellers
Run it from the CEO office

rounds.title: Operating model
rounds.brief: Costs are under control; now you need revenue quality.

options.text: Revenue management system with AI pricing
Direct booking site and OTA renegotiation
Rehire laid-off staff with retention bonuses

rounds.title: Recapitalisation
rounds.brief: Lenders will refinance only with a credible long-term structure.

options.text: Sale and leaseback of two hotels
Partner with a global hotel brand
